description: Packing lunch is easy with these sturdy, reusable bags specifically designed to work with Lunchbox containers (sold separately). Lunchbox modular containers snap together in multiple configurations to efficiently use the space in your lunch box or bag. Mesh pockets inside and out hold drink bottles, utensils and napkins securely in place. The entire front zips open for easy access.
